protocol.purpose: Frozen representation probe before considering a severity auxiliary head. No RL or surrogate training.
protocol.data: DARROW recorded train188 and development val40 days only; never extract test rows
protocol.probe_date_split: Sorted train dates: first112 fit, next38 tune, last38 holdout. Existing encoders were trained on all188 train days; only probe fitting holds these dates out.
protocol.features: Current normalized observation11 and current recorded total air action. Trained or same-seed initial frozen encoder z64. No future actions or measurements in features.
targets: sum of positive NH4 excess above4 over next4 observations times0.25h, mg h/L
protocol.windows: t=0..91 in each96-row day, future indices t+1..t+4, no crossing day boundaries

ridge.select: minimum tune-date MAE per target and seed, no refit

controls: current target and future window indexing
protocol.interpretation: Prediction under recorded operation is not a causal action-response estimate. A probe can miss nonlinear information. Raw observation bypass means latent probe failure is not total policy information loss. Probe losses do not prove control improvement. No architecture is auto-adopted or RL auto-launched from these scores.
protocol.review_rule: A trained-z advantage is only a descriptive signal if future-target raw-plus-trained-z ridge MAE is at least10% below raw ridge and raw-plus-initial-z on probe holdout for at least4/5 seeds. Also report nonlinear raw control and val separately. This heuristic is not a statistical significance or control success threshold.
